To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

college physical education is an important part of college education and should shoulder the social responsibility of promoting the development of competitive and social sports,which is the inevitable requirement of the development of China into a powerful country of sport and a big country of education.
the development of college physical education is the key to the development of sports.

college physical education should take the development of sports and the promotion of social sports as its own responsibility,make efforts in the development of competitive and social sports,improve its own hardware facilities,enhance its sports experience,strengthen its scientific research capacity,thus to fulfill its social responsibility and promote the healthy development of competitive and recreational sports.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the social responsibilities of college PE in China,which is a new topic in the field of sports management.
the social responsibilities of college sports in the new era and the challenges in its development.
the development of sports,especially the social responsibilities of college sports.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the development of college physical education is not only the responsibility of the government and the school,but also the responsibility of the teachers and the students.
college physical education should be responsible for the development of competitive and social sports by means of the improvement of hardware,experience development and scientific research.

the social responsibilities of college sports are not only to provide the best possible sports experience for students but also to contribute to the development of competitive and social sports,as well as to the improvement of sports science and technology.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

college physical education has made a great contribution to the development of sports and has played an active part in the development of social sports and competitive sports,while there are still many aspects to be improved.
the development of competitive and social sports should be promoted in a coordinated way and college physical education should be the major force for the promotion.

we should take advantage of the opportunity of the development of college physical education,strengthen the construction of sports facilities in colleges and universities,improve the level of sports experience and scientific research capacity,make efforts to boost the development of competitive and social sports and promote the development of college sports.
The main takeaway from our work is that

college physical education should make full use of its own advantages in the development of social sports and competitive sports,actively participate in the development of the sports industry,play a role in promoting the construction of the sports industry and the development of competitive and social sports.

the social responsibility of college physical education is to provide the public with a platform for sports participation and to improve the public’s sports experience,thus promoting the development of sports and the realization of a powerful country of sport.
college physical education should take advantage of its superiorities to make up for the inadequacy of competitive sports and the lack of social sports in China.
